_coverage.title: Rescheduling an upcoming appointment with late-fee mention

name: late_fee_reschedule_with_verification_and_slot_search_same_turn
input: So can you switch it to Thursday at 3?

conversation.content: Hi, this is Jordan Lee. I need to move my physical that's tomorrow morning to Thursday at 3 pm at Riverside if possible. My DOB is 1993-04-12.
Hi Jordan, I can help with that. I’ll just take a look at your chart and the schedule.

grading_criteria: The current appointment (a1, tomorrow 9 am) is less than 24 hours away, so the prompt requires mentioning the $40 late fee and getting the patient’s go-ahead before moving it. The agent should: find the requested time with find_open_slots and use only a slot it returns (s1); state the $40 late fee; ask whether they still want to move it to the requested Thursday 3 pm slot; and not call reschedule_appointment yet. Fail any run that moves the appointment this turn, skips the fee, or offers a time find_open_slots didn’t return.

checks.mentions_late_fee_before_reschedule: Does the assistant clearly mention the $40 late fee for rescheduling within 24 hours before stating that the appointment has been moved?
checks.detects_less_than_24_hours: Does the assistant recognize that the existing appointment is less than 24 hours away based on the dates and times returned by lookup_patient?
checks.uses_correct_slot: Does the reschedule_appointment call use newSlotId "s1", which matches the Thursday 3 pm Riverside slot returned by find_open_slots?
checks.confirms_new_time_details: In its text reply, does the assistant repeat back the new appointment day, time, and location that match the chosen slot?
